title: External Connector
description: A capability bound to an HTTPS endpoint an operator runs, and to the policy that governs it, registered through external connector changes (ADR-0013). Nothing is deleted: a revoked registration stays listed.

registrationId.description: The changeId of the approved register change that created it.

status.description: At most one active registration per capability.

revokedByChangeId.description: revoked only: the approved change that revoked it.
